Subject: Renewal conversation + isolation for analytics workload

Kimberly —

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for Redwood Dedicated is up in mid-September and we’re evaluating a modest expansion tied to an isolation requirement for our analytics/ML workloads. High level:
- We need two additional clusters (analytics-isolated) to separate PII-handling inference from our general-production models.
- We’re looking to extend the term to 36 months for price stability if the overall run-rate improves.
- Would like a rough delta on cost and a rough timeline for provisioning on-prem or VPC-isolated clusters.

I’ve attached a short brief describing our traffic split and a preliminary SOW needs list (Mediforge-SOW-Needs.pdf). Can we lock a 30-minute call this week to go over options and a MAP toward signing? Procurement will need a ballpark estimate to include in their budget review.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex —

Thanks for the brief and the doc. We can definitely support an isolated analytics footprint; there are a few different ways to approach this depending on whether you prefer private on-prem clusters, VPC-only isolation, or a hybrid with dedicated pools. Quick asks before the call so we come prepared:
1) Target QPS / avg token rates for analytics models vs production (ballpark is fine).
2) Any hard constraints on cross-region failover or data egress.
3) Security/compliance reviewers we should loop in early (SOC2, encryption, KMS).

If it helps, Dev will send a quick capacity sketch and a cost delta estimate after the call.

Best,

Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + isolation for analytics workload — initial capacity sketch

Alex / Kim —

Following up from the call earlier today — summary of the recommended technical approach:
- Recommendation: two isolated clusters (analytics-iso-1, analytics-iso-2) in your AWS VPC with private link peering back to the app tier; fallback to a single dedicated on-prem cluster if you need air-gapped operations.
- Size guidance: each cluster: 8 x A100-equivalent GPU nodes for sustained batch workloads; smaller 2–4 GPU burst nodes for low-latency reranking requests.
- Storage/IO: separate KV-caching layers, 24h TTL for ephemeral caches; persistent artifacts on customer-managed S3 (we can support connectors).
- Timeline: 4–6 weeks for VPC provisioning + canary testing; 8–10 weeks for an on-prem hardware procurement + installation plan.
- Migration window: phased cutover over two weekends with fallback rollback plan.

Attached a working capacity worksheet (capacity-estimate.xlsx) — please review the assumed QPS columns. Pricing delta ballpark: +18–24% on current committed run-rate for a 12-month renewal; for a 36-month term we can bring that down to +10–12% (subject to final cluster sizing/discount tiers).

If Mediforge has a dedicated KMS/HSM requirement, we’ll need that detail for the on-prem plan.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: capacity-estimate.xlsx
